description_en: Queries raw log data from a specified Logstore in a project and returns raw logs within a specified time range. The results are compressed before transmission
description_zh: 查询指定Project下某个Logstore中的原始日志数据，返回结果显示某时间区间中的原始日志（返回结果压缩后传输）
kebab_example: aliyun sls get-logs-v2 --project ali-test-project --logstore test-logstore --accept-encoding lz4 --from 1627268185 --to 1627268185 --line 100 --offset 0 --reverse false --power-sql false --session mode=scan --topic example-string --query status:_401_SELECT_remote_addr,COUNT_0_as_pv_GROUP_by_remote_addr_ORDER_by_pv_desc_limit_5 --forward false --highlight false --is-accurate true --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetLogsV2

parameters.help_en:
The compression method for the response content. SDK users do not need to specify this parameter because the SDK automatically handles compression and decompression.

- Java, Python, and Go currently support lz4 and gzip decompression.

- php, JavaScript, and C# currently support only gzip decompression
parameters.help_zh:
返回内容的压缩方式。sdk 用户无需指定，由 sdk 自动处理压缩与解压。

- Java、Python、Go目前支持lz4 、gzip 解压缩

- php、Js、C#目前仅支持gzip解压缩
parameters.name: accept_encoding

parameters.help_en:
The start time of the query. This time refers to the log time specified when log data is written.

The time range defined by the from and to request parameters follows the left-closed, right-open principle. The time range includes the start time but excludes the end time. If the values of from and to are the same, the time range is invalid and the function returns an error.
The value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of seconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC
parameters.help_zh:
查询开始时间点。该时间是指写入日志数据时指定的日志时间。

请求参数from和to定义的时间区间遵循左闭右开原则，即该时间区间包括区间开始时间点，但不包括区间结束时间点。如果from和to的值相同，则为无效区间，函数直接返回错误。
Unix时间戳格式，表示从1970-1-1 00:00:00 UTC计算起的秒数
parameters.name: from

parameters.help_en:
The end time of the query. This time refers to the log time specified when log data is written.

The time range defined by the from and to request parameters follows the left-closed, right-open principle. The time range includes the start time but excludes the end time. If the values of from and to are the same, the time range is invalid and the function returns an error.
The value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of seconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC
parameters.help_zh:
查询结束时间点。该时间是指写入日志数据时指定的日志时间。

请求参数from和to定义的时间区间遵循左闭右开原则，即该时间区间包括区间开始时间点，但不包括区间结束时间点。如果from和to的值相同，则为无效区间，函数直接返回错误。
Unix时间戳格式，表示从1970-1-1 00:00:00 UTC计算起的秒数
parameters.name: to

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of logs to return. This parameter is valid only when the query parameter is a query statement (not an analytic statement). Minimum value: 0. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 请求返回的最大日志条数。仅当query参数为查询语句（非 SQL 分析语句）时，该参数有效。最小值为0，最大值为100，默认值为100
parameters.name: line

parameters.help_en: The row from which the query starts. This parameter is valid only when the query parameter is a query statement (not an analytic statement). The value starts from 0. Default value: 0
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始行。仅当query参数为查询语句（非 SQL 分析语句）时，该参数有效。值从 0 开始，默认值为 0
parameters.name: offset

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to return logs in reverse chronological order of log timestamps, accurate to the minute level. This parameter is valid only when the query parameter is a query statement (not an analytic statement).

- true: Returns logs in descending order of log timestamps.
- false (default): Returns logs in ascending order of log timestamps.

To sort results in an analytic statement, use the ORDER BY syntax. If ORDER BY is set to asc (default), logs are returned in ascending order. If ORDER BY is set to desc, logs are returned in descending order
parameters.help_zh:
用于指定返回结果是否按日志时间戳降序返回日志，精确到分钟级别。仅当 query 为查询语句（非 SQL 分析语句）时有效。

- true：按照日志时间戳降序返回日志。
- false（默认值）：按照日志时间戳升序返回日志。

如需在SQL分析语句中排序，请使用 order by 语法指定排序方式。如果 order by为asc（默认），则为升序；如果order by为desc，则为降序
parameters.name: reverse

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable Dedicated SQL. Disabled by default
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启独享版 SQL，默认关闭
parameters.name: power_sql

parameters.help_en: The topic. Default value: empty string
parameters.name: topic

parameters.example: status: 401 | SELECT remote_addr,COUNT(*) as pv GROUP by remote_addr ORDER by pv desc limit 5
parameters.help_en:
The query statement or analytic statement. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/43772.html and https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/53608.html.

Add set session parallel_sql=true; to the analytic statement in the query parameter to use Dedicated SQL. Example: * | set session parallel_sql=true; select count(*) as pv.

Note: When the query parameter contains an analytic statement (SQL statement), the line and offset parameters of this API are invalid. Set them to 0. Use the LIMIT syntax in the SQL statement for pagination. For more information, see Display query and analysis results by page
parameters.help_zh:
查询语句或者分析语句。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/43772.html和https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/53608.html。

在query参数的分析语句中加上set session parallel_sql=true;，表示使用SQL独享版。例如* | set session parallel_sql=true; select count(*) as pv 。

说明当query参数中有分析语句（SQL语句）时，该接口的line参数和offset参数无效，建议设置为0，需通过SQL语句的LIMIT语法实现翻页。更多信息，请参见分页显示查询分析结果
parameters.name: query

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to page forward or backward for scan or phrase queries
parameters.help_zh: scan或短语查询表示是否向前或向后翻页
parameters.name: forward

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable nanosecond-precision ordering
parameters.name: is_accurate
